name: DFW Quiet Qualifier 2025

venue.name: The University of Texas at Dallas - Student Union

information: ##### **This is not a normal competition with common events like 3x3 and 2x2. This competition features "quiet" and less common events. For a more normal competition experience, check out the [many other competitions happening in Texas](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=USA&search=Texas&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&show_registration_status=on&display=list), including [DFW Qualifier 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DFWQualifier2025), happening the day after in Arlington.** - Please review the [Competitor Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DFWQuietQualifier2025#57552-competitor-information) tab before the competition. - Please review the other tabs for more information on the competition. Please note that the [schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DFWQuietQualifier2025#competition-schedule) is subject to change, as we may hold events slightly earlier or later than shown depending on whether the competition is running ahead of schedule or behind schedule. The University of Texas at Dallas and the Comet Cubing Club will not take custodial responsibility of minors while participating in DFW Quiet Qualifier 2025. Custodial responsibility will remain with teachers K-12, parents, legal guardians, and chaperones. This competition is supported by Southern Cubing LLC. To learn more about cubing in the Southern USA, including other competitions, visit [Southern Cubing](https://www.southerncubing.com/). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NjUxMzcsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--9863833688a5f44433b5f4dc6d8a75f973072f10/southernCubing%203-01.png)
